item.title: Out Our Way: Quirt, spurs and reins

item.title: Looking out my Backdoor: "Stayin' Alive"
item.description: This will be a shortie. I'm down with a flu. Most everybody has had a flu at least once so you know how I feel. item.title: Havre man dies in house fire
item.description: A Havre man died as a result of a house fire on the 900 Block of Fifth Avenue the morning of Wednesday, Jan. 14. Kurt Pehl, 56, died as a result of injuries from the fire.
